problemStatement: Understand Introduction to Priority Queues using Binary Heaps deeply enough to use it in later problems in “Heaps [Learning, Medium, Hard Problems]”.
intuition: "Introduction to Priority Queues using Binary Heaps" needs LIFO/FIFO or a monotonic stack/queue. Push when deferring work; pop when the deferred item becomes due.
